gen-almendra-display-gf-martel-sans: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display lets its letters stay open and its x-height stand tall above the line. And Martel Sans follows in a modern, generous hand, with wide curves and a high mean line running through every word.
gen-almendra-display-gf-matangi: Almendra Display carries a literary, ornate air, with open-mouthed letters and a pronounced x-height. But Matangi is the sturdier one, its rounded forms pressed like twine into a flat surface and its lowercase hefty and wide.
gen-almendra-display-gf-michroma: Ornate, wide-eyed and a bit theatrical up top. Almendra Display keeps its letters open, while Michroma gives each character a wide berth and a tall-bodied lowercase with stubby ascender tips, so the plain sans below feels almost technical.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads with a very large lowercase eye, each letter hanging like a clothespin on a long line. Mochiy Pop One keeps that laser-cut single stroke width going down the page, while Almendra Display above it stays ornate and literary.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Fancy meets friendly here. Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary heading with a pronounced x-height, and Mochiy Pop P One sits beneath it with wide gaps between letters and crossbars as thick as its stems.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mozilla-text: Literary and ornate, Almendra Display opens things up with generous letters. Mozilla Text follows in a sans that looks bold simply because its lowercase bodies are so tall, with terminals that flare outward line after line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads like it was drawn with a technical pen, with a large central band and curves left wide open. Almendra Display above it is the ornate, literary foil to that ruler-straight line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-nobile: Nobile reads tight and tidy, with little gap between its x-height and its capitals. Over a full page its open letter mouths, like a chalk arc left unjoined, keep a plain sans from feeling closed in under Almendra Display.
gen-almendra-display-gf-nokora: Ornate flourish up top, a dark steady stripe below. If Almendra Display were made small, its literary detail would shrink, and Nokora's thick lowercase and wide-open s would simply keep the page moving.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display leads with open letters and a pronounced x-height. And Noto Kufi Arabic follows in a modern, clean plain sans, its welcoming c gap and low capitals giving the heading room to be the showpiece.
